Name: Vanilla Wizard 32 Portraits
Author: Buncisoup
Description:
RRRR uses Chaekal's Wizard design by default. But if you dig the base game wizard [s]or you need the standard overworld sprites like I do[/s], here you go!

Adds 32 portraits wizard in vanilla design and artstyle.
Includes modified SVE sprite and beach sprite.

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size][spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Extract Vanilla Wizard 32 Portraits into Mods folder
[*]Run the game by running the SMAPI.exe
[/list]To uninstall this mod, simply remove '[i][CP] Vanilla Wizard 32 Portraits[/i]' folder from '[i]Mods[/i]' folder

If the mod doesn't seem to work, please check mod compatibility guide
[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Mod Compatibility
[/b][/size][spoiler]
Other portrait/sprite-changing mods that includes Wizard [i][b](incl. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url])[/b][/i] are incompatible by default as the mods will replace each other.
I added priority system to help with this. But if it still gets overwritten by other mods, disable Wizard's assets on the other mods by any (or multiple, if required) of these methods:
[list]
[*]Editing config, if they let you disable Wizard's portrait/sprite by config [i](ex: RRRR "Sprite" setting to "Use custom")[/i]
[*]Deleting Wizard's assets/images from other mod [i](Magnus on SVE's 'OverworldSprite' and 'Portraits' folders)[/i]
[*]Renaming '[i][CP] Vanilla Wizard 32 Portraits[/i]' folder so it loads after the other mods [i](ex: [CP] ... -> z[CP] ... )[/i]
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][size=4]Configuration Options﻿[/size][/b]
[spoiler]
If you only want to use the sprites, you can disable the portrait
﻿[b]DisablePortrait[/b]: true, [u]false
[/u]
RRRR prefers wizard to have scars. By default, if you have RRRR, the Wizard would have scars visible on the beach portraits.
Toggle "[i]always[/i]" to give him scars even without RRRR (somehow?), or toggle "[i]disable[/i]" to remove scars.
[b] ﻿﻿EnableScar[/b]: [u]auto[/u], always, disable

[/spoiler]
